note: Recorded legacy for the ticket-trailer rule over LANDED history (issue #287). Every commit here landed AFTER the shared predicate's enforcement boundary and still does not carry the ticket reference in a trailing trailer block, as measured -- not assumed -- by `scripts/check-pr-contract.sh --landed`. They are RECORDED, not accepted: `governance/isolation/cli.py enforce` reports them on every run. An entry is ADDED only by an explicit, reviewed commit to this file -- never automatically, and never to silence a run. That review IS the control, and it is the only admissible terminal state for post-boundary residue: the commit is already squash-merged onto a protected branch, so its message cannot be corrected (history is never rewritten, GR hard floor), and the gate that caught it has no other way to close. A NEW violation therefore still reds the gate FIRST; recording it is the follow-up decision, not the fix (#836). Nothing is ever dropped from this list silently: an entry whose commit now complies (`quarantine-entry-stale`) or is outside the assessed range (`quarantine-entry-not-assessed`) fails the check, and a missing or malformed baseline fails rather than skipping. The list SHRANK by issue #835 (2026-09-15): the predicate's trailer line now includes GitHub's own bare auto-close keyword (`Closes #<n>`), which is the paragraph the landing path composes (`gh pr merge --squash` over a body ending in a bare `Closes #<n>`), so the 8 entries whose trailing paragraph had that shape now COMPLY -- each re-checked, the shared predicate reporting rc 0 for it -- and were removed. 14 entries became 6. The 6 that remain are the shapes the rule still refuses by design: the reference separated from the trailing block by prose (`commit-ref-outside-the-trailer-block`), or no reference at all (`commit-missing-ticket-trailer`). The list GREW by one entry by issue #1154 (2026-09-17): `origin/master`'s own tip `2fa292c` (the squash-merge of #1150) carried no trailing trailer and was not recorded, so `scripts/check-isolation-landed.sh` refused a pristine `origin/master` (rc=1) and blocked every open PR's `make verify`. The composition surfaces were intact -- the PR template ends in the trailer and the landing driver composes one -- and the queue's pre-merge guard refuses this very PR when run directly (`bash scripts/check-squash-message.sh --pr 1150` -> rc=1 `commit-missing-ticket-trailer`); #1150 was instead merged DIRECTLY by the owner (kushin77, 2026-09-17T16:05:52Z), bypassing `scripts/pr-queue.sh` and its guard. The gap is therefore ENFORCEMENT on the non-queue merge path (findings filed to #1145), not composition; recording this residue is the review-gated terminal state the doctrine requires, and it does not prevent the next direct merge. It recurred within three minutes of #1169 (the #1154 fix) landing: #1171 (`0aa836c`, merged directly by the owner 2026-09-17T17:38:25Z, its own body declaring `check-isolation-landed` a pre-existing failure) redded master before the fix could be observed green -- recorded by issue #1172, and the measured proof that recording residue is not prevention.
